title: Sam Altman & OpenAI | 2023 Hawking Fellow | Cambridge Union
summary: Sam Altman accepts the 2023 Hawking Fellowship at the Cambridge Union and speaks about OpenAI, AGI and AI safety, recorded November 1, 2023. It includes his comments on what is left for AGI and on discovering new physics.
why: During the Altman ouster threads, HN mined it for his recent unscripted statements on AGI and safety; some also mock its tone.

quote.text: 2 days ago, Sam is asked about what's left for AGI.
